A broad-shouldered man, meticulously uniformed with a weathered ledger case never far from his hand. A pale scar crosses his left eyebrow. His manner is formal, controlled, and he looks at you with an eye that seems to miss little. He speaks with quiet authority. 

What do you wish to discuss with me?

text: I've heard a caravan went missing and the watch has asked me to look into it

speaker: npc
text: Missing, you say? Precise details are needed, not hearsay. Which caravan specifically, and what was its last known position? This matter falls under my responsibility, so any information you have will be formally recorded. Who sent you, by the way?
